draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.95, the 165th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 21st of 32 at WR. He went 185th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 611 receiving yards in 2022, 24th of 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Jacksonville Jaguars. 42 career games and 15 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (10 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 10 (92nd percentile), receiving yards 847 (80th percentile), team target share 17.4% (79th percentile). Weak spots: drop rate 7.4% (16th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 wide receiver who played: 847 receiving yards against a median of 346, above the norm.
